svg.text: bg_core_pd: reference-current core of bias_bg_pd, cut from that flat sheet (core devices and their wiring only).
iout: the core output (POC drain) into the tree input; en_3v3 / en_3v3_b: enable and its complement (from inv_3v3_pd).
Disabled: MS1 off (gate en_3v3_b), SKS pulls ks to vss, SVPG pulls vpg to vdd, so PO / POC are off and iout is high-Z.
R0, R1A, R1B as drawn (compact layout): chains of 18 / 11 / 10 rhigh
segments 0.5u / 9.94u, as vector instances R0[17:0], R1A[10:0], R1B[9:0];
the bus labels name the chain nodes (eb, n0[16] ... n0[0], e2).
Each segment has its own heads: R +0.70 % (R0), +1.03 % (R1A), +1.02 % (R1B)
8 x 0.5u / 12.5u, vdd to ks, gates en_3v3_b
PMOS: D = S = bulk = vdd, gates vpg / vpc
NMOS: D = S = G = g (Vgs = 0), bulk vss; rhigh: both ends vss
Since 2026-10-28 backannotated from the compact layout (layout/gds/bg_core_pd.gds): resistors as chains [C], NA / NB ng 2 (W, L as before), MS1 as drawn [S1], dummies [D].
